title: Direct executable neural weight construction from charged experience with cumulative learning

parent.prior: WSP66 structured pair policy lost to random (169/1024 vs 489/1024); WSP53 direct acoustic writer had negative/tied controls; full inherited WSP66 pending.

question: Can source-blind, no-gradient learning write real executable neural weights from physical experience, generalize to unobserved action-state outcomes, compose unseen two-action sequences, retain skills across another learning phase, and compete with exact memory, independent symbolic inference and fully trained gradient neural controls?

source.physics: Four binary visible sensors and four unknown permuted action channels; each action toggles one/two bits conditioned on constant or conjunction of at most two possibly negated input bits, with unknown randomly permuted causal roles. Strong source-aligned given hypothesis prior.
source.training: Single seeded-uniform-random 96-action continuous no-reset charged source session per world; Stage A 64, Stage B +32; identical public rows to every arm; no arbitrary-state query or source import.
source.audit: 8 ×16 states×4 actions=512 exhaustive source transition audits, explicitly previously unseen vs trained observations. Additionally 32 independent evaluator-selected two-action sequences/world (256 composites), no source intermediate used by learner.

learner.writer: Enumerate constant/at-most-two-input conjunctive candidate flip effects for each action/output from charged rows. Build real numeric W1,b1,W2,b2,W3,b3 three-affine-layer ReLU neural network with conjunction detectors and residual XOR; write a confidence head that encodes unanimous safe state/action contexts. Only the neural dense-matrix forward pass may predict heldout outputs; no candidate-table lookup/source access at inference. No gradients.
learner.phases: Store Stage A neural matrices, add Stage B observations, directly rewrite matrices from accumulated evidence; audit no forgetting of Stage A correct/confident predictions, real weight modifications, cold restore and tamper rejection.
controls: Same-96-evidence direct state/action lookup with two-step composition
Independently implemented evidence-consistent symbolic causal predicate rule learner with same structural prior

Independent seeded 8-input, 24-hidden ReLU, four sigmoid output conventional SGD neural net; 8000 steps or ≥98% train-side exact observed accuracy after 2000 steps, report incomplete if unconverged; same source rows, no oracle

score: Direct learner confidently correct only when matrix confidence >=0.5 and four neural output bits exactly match source; otherwise wrong confident or abstain. Gradient baseline reports forced prediction and confident predictions at ≥0.9 per-bit probability. No heldout-driven calibration.
primary: SELFTEST_SIGNAL if and only if Stage B (A) >=48 correct confident true UNOBSERVED action-state transitions across eight worlds, (B) zero wrong-confident across 512 source audits, (C) >=120/256 new two-action compositions solved with both neural steps confident, (D) >=20 more all-domain correct vs equal-evidence exact lookup, (E) no loss of Stage A correct/confident predictions, (F) nonzero neural weight changes in >=4/8 worlds, and (G) matrix cold restoration and tamper rejection pass all eight. Otherwise NEGATIVE_OR_INCONCLUSIVE; no after-result threshold tuning.
metrics: Source/task/charged history SHA256, full 512 audit and 256 compositions
Stage A/B predictions, cold-retention, changed/nonzero neural parameters, memory and total CPU/wall
Independent symbolic result, gradient training convergence/update count, observed/heldout accuracy, costs
Zero-gradient count for direct writer; source isolation and abort on malformed/corrupt matrices
limitations: Predefined low-degree causal predicate family and Boolean sensors exactly match synthetic physics, so not open-world general intelligence or emergent representation learning.
Compiler does symbolic inference when writing neural parameters, although prediction must occur exclusively via matrix forward; no claim of fully neural autonomous weight synthesis.
No language, high dimensional input or unseen physics-family transfer; action budget matched, model computation may differ.
An unconverged SGD baseline cannot support superiority claims.
stop_rules: Freeze BEFORE any WSP67 source/model/test code or outcomes
Do not change seeds, budgets, goal criteria or model prior after results; documented mechanical harness repairs only
Exact-source dual-OS focused, G29, and full regression before engineering closure
Do not change old WSP outcomes, merge, promote, or deploy
